purpose: Research-only evidence packet for five individually verified Dublin City NIAH structures

source_snapshot.queue_rule: Each selected registration number was checked as an exact entry in the workflow-generated Dublin missing-registration queue.

official_dataset_reference.title: NIAH Data Download
official_dataset_reference.note: The official national CSV provides ITM coordinates and latitude/longitude. Individual-page coordinate pairs below are preserved separately as raw values because the individual page does not label the CRS.

candidate_records.name: INDN Express/Swift Couriers
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010101 present in Dublin missing-registration queue.
candidate_records.research_notes: Attached end-of-terrace two-bay two-storey house over raised basement, built c.1840, with a shared rear return. NIAH describes it as one of ten similar houses and states that it terminates the south end of a terrace of ten paired former townhouses. Much external fabric is described as replaced at survey time. The terrace context is a relationship, not a reason to merge this registered house with neighbouring properties.

candidate_records.name: 58 Amiens Street
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010106 present in Dublin missing-registration queue.
candidate_records.research_notes: Terraced two-bay three-storey house over raised basement, built c.1830 and described as offices at survey time. The appraisal notes survival of the restrained Doric doorcase and much of the original form and fabric. NIAH notes the shared granite platform with its neighbour; this is a shared feature, not a separate object.

candidate_records.name: 2 Preston Street
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010110 present in Dublin missing-registration queue.
candidate_records.research_notes: Terraced three-bay three-storey house over raised basement, built c.1810, one of a terrace of four. NIAH notes survival of much early fenestration and a fine Adamesque doorcase. Keep as a distinct registered house within the terrace.

candidate_records.name: 1 Preston Street
candidate_records.address: 1 Preston Street / Amiens Street corner, Dublin 1, Ireland
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010111 present in Dublin missing-registration queue.
candidate_records.research_notes: End-of-terrace, corner-sited three-bay three-storey house over raised basement, built c.1810 and one of a terrace of four. It has a single-bay address to Amiens Street and terminates the terrace at the corner. NIAH highlights a fine Adamesque doorcase and early door furniture. The corner treatment is part of this registered building, not an independent record.

candidate_records.name: 107 Amiens Street
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010112 present in Dublin missing-registration queue.
candidate_records.research_notes: Terraced three-bay three-storey house over raised basement, built c.1810 and one of a group of three. NIAH describes a fine Adamesque doorcase and early Georgian proportions. Keep this as a separate building registration within its group.

duplicate_screen.method: Exact registration-number searches against open repository issues and pull requests.
duplicate_screen.result: No open issue or pull request matches returned for any of the five exact registration numbers at time of research.

spatial_and_identity_cautions: 50010101 belongs to a terrace of ten paired former townhouses; retain its own registration and do not merge it with the terrace as one building object.
50010106 is a separate house on Amiens Street; its shared entrance platform with a neighbour is not a separate archive object.
50010110 and 50010111 are separate houses in the four-house Preston Street terrace. 50010111 is the corner/end-of-terrace building at Amiens Street.
50010112 is a separate registered house in a group of three on Amiens Street.
The Amiens Street and Preston Street addresses form a local research cluster but are not asserted to be one architectural ensemble.
Individual NIAH page coordinate pairs are preserved as raw values because the page does not label their CRS. Do not interpret them as EPSG:2157 or overwrite official CSV coordinates.
NIAH use, fabric and condition descriptions are survey-time statements, not present-day field verification.
No physical access, ownership, public access or current condition has been verified.
explicitly_not_done: No visual inventory or source registry imports
No map pins or coordinate imports
